explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 102 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 15 current-techno pages, current charts, release pages and adjacent catalogue paths. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: All required canonical, discussion, revisit, history, map and publication state passed pre-audit; no REPAIR is actionable.
Every canonical, previously evaluated, PARKED, placement-specific REJECT, preserved alternate, unresolved identity and repository-wide utility identity was excluded.
Nine leads come from nine releases; the recurring-PARK evidence guard was applied.
Planned boundaries avoid those evaluated in the previous five completed discovery runs. Failed Run 276 supplies no musical evidence.
Release prose is attributed rather than measured; exact identity and musical dimensions require resolver or lawful evidence.
Neither listener-protected internal handoff is split.
